hooks.command: command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1 && uv tool install --quiet --python 3.12 "${MEMBRAIN_PACKAGE:-membrain-ai[embedded,semantic] @ git+https://github.com/chriswu727/membrain}" >/dev/null 2>&1; uvx --offline --python 3.12 --from membrain-ai membrain plugin start >/dev/null 2>&1; true
command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1 && uvx --offline --python 3.12 --from membrain-ai membrain plugin hook session-start 2>/dev/null; true

input=$(cat); if command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1 && printf '%s' "$input" | uvx --offline --python 3.12 --from membrain-ai membrain plugin hook user-prompt 2>/dev/null; then :; elif [ -n "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA" ]; then mkdir -p "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA" && { printf '%s' "$input" | tr -d '\n'; echo; } >> "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA/pending-hooks.jsonl"; fi; true

input=$(cat); if command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1 && printf '%s' "$input" | uvx --offline --python 3.12 --from membrain-ai membrain plugin hook stop 2>/dev/null; then :; elif [ -n "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA" ]; then mkdir -p "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA" && { printf '%s' "$input" | tr -d '\n'; echo; } >> "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA/pending-hooks.jsonl"; fi; true
